sources.description: The Denver Broncos got some good news on the injury front as they prepare to play the San Francisco 49ers this weekend. Both wide receivers Jaylen Waddle and Marvin Mims Jr. were full participants. We knew Mims was working back, but there were rumors Waddle was in a boot after last week’s game. All looks […]
